I found two sites in #central-team that are clearly Marrow Agrisupply, plus one that might be:

1. Eastbank: in Hollis's message of Jun 9, 2026, 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached. The file calls the doors E1/E2 but their booking sheet uses 01/02. Hollis said this has to be sorted before anyone reimports, or it will create duplicates.
2. Pine Crossing: in your message of Jun 9, 2026, 10:48 AM. The appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so the morning receiver couldn't book a driver who arrived at 7:10. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce it with the store login.
3. Wichita (not confirmed): from your message of Jul 2, 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with "the Wichita store dispatcher" right after Tobias said your Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours. That suggests Wichita is a Marrow store, but the message never actually says so.

Don't count the Tulsa hub. It came up in the same Jul 2025 thread, but it belongs to Tansley Parcel.

The Jun 9 escalation also mentions three rows on Marrow's rollout tracker that just say "waiting", but no store names are given. Nothing I can see in the channel says how those store calls went or whether the blockers got fixed.
